profile.name: Omar Márquez
profile.about:
​Software Engineering student and Full-Stack Web Developer with 2 years of experience building efficient and scalable digital solutions. Being a highly driven, self-taught professional allows me to stay at the forefront of technology, mastering modern ecosystems built around TypeScript, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.
 I am highly enthusiastic about designing robust software architectures—ranging from gRPC implementations to high-performance applications with offline-first capabilities. As a responsible and committed developer, I do not just write code; I strive to deeply understand business needs to ensure that every technical effort delivers tangible value to the end product. I am eager to join a dynamic startup or innovative organization where I can take on ownership, solve critical technical challenges, and help scale projects from the ground up.
